name: Kama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kama city emblem in green, light blue and red: a green ring crossed by a light blue swoosh, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kama, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 2006.
